# GOFO Rolls Out a New Next-Generation Automated Sorting Center at Its Lyon Hub

08 Sep, 2026, 15:36 GMT

LYON, France and PARIS, Sept. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- GOFO, a last-mile delivery provider expanding rapidly across France, announces the installation of a new automated sorting system, a first in France, at its Lyon sorting hub. Its launch, scheduled for late November 2026, will mark a new milestone in the development of the company's French network. 

A new sorting system, unique in France, to support growing parcel volumes

 

Lyon Automated Sorting Center.

With this sorting technology unmatched anywhere else in France, the Lyon hub sets itself apart from the company's second hub in Bonneuil, near Paris, which relies on a traditional linear sorter. This new equipment will enable GOFO to keep pace with growing parcel volumes while balancing cost control, operational flexibility, and service quality for its merchant partners and their customers.

17 August 2026 13 min read News

## Key Takeaways

* Leadership Shift: Snabbit has appointed Pradeep Yadav, co-founder of Klydo, as its new Head of Operations to drive strategic expansion across Tier-1 and Tier-2 cities.

* Hiring Signal: Leadership changes at the CXO or Head level in Indian startups typically precede a 20-30% increase in mid-to-junior level hiring within 90 days.

* Sector Growth: This move confirms that the consumer services sector (competing with Zomato, Swiggy, and Dunzo) is entering a high-growth phase in late 2026.

* Resume Strategy: To land a role at Snabbit or similar high-growth startups, your resume must move beyond generic descriptions and focus on operational efficiency and unit economics.

* Salary Trends: Operations roles in companies like Snabbit currently offer a CTC (Cost to Company) ranging from ₹12 LPA to ₹25 LPA for mid-level managers, with an in-hand component usually being 70-75% of the gross amount.
